Class ExpressionTrees

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.expression.tree.ExpressionTrees

      public static ExpressionNode.Operator asRoot(ExpressionNode node)
      The root of an expression is an operator, so a value, parameter, reference or empty slot as a whole expression is the input of the identity operator, which is not written in its text.

      Returns:

    • isPlainOperator

      public static boolean isPlainOperator(Expression expression)
      Check if the given expression can be stored as a plain operator variable, which is the case for a single operator without parameters and only variable references as inputs.
      Parameters:
      expression - An expression.
      Returns:
      If it is equivalent to a plain operator variable.
